title: How Do I: Replace Reports with Analysis Mode in Business Central
summary: Analysis Mode on Business Central list pages can replace many traditional reports for data exploration and ad-hoc questions like customer balances and inventory movements, eliminating the need for custom report development while enabling users to answer follow-up questions independently.
key_points: Analysis Mode works best for answering questions rather than producing formatted documents for distribution
Common reports like Top Customers by Balance and Vendor Balance to Date can be recreated using grouping, aggregation, and filtering on ledger entry pages
Interactive exploration with pivoting and drill-down replaces static exports to Excel
Classic reports remain necessary for statutory requirements, complex calculations, and external distribution needs

quotes.text: If a report exists mainly to answer a question, rather than to produce a document, Analysis Mode is usually the better option.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides a clear decision rule for when to use Analysis Mode versus traditional reports
